\textbf{(a)} By parts, $u=\tan^{-1}x$, $dv=x^2dx$:
\[\frac{x^3}{3}\tan^{-1}x-\frac13\int\frac{x^3}{1+x^2}dx,\qquad \frac{x^3}{1+x^2}=x-\frac{x}{1+x^2}.\]
\[\boxed{\frac{x^3}{3}\tan^{-1}x-\frac{x^2}{6}+\frac16\ln(1+x^2)+C}.\]
\textbf{(b)} Let $u=\sqrt x$, $dx=2u\,du$:
\[\int\frac{2(u^2+4)}{u(1+u)^2}du,\qquad \frac{2(u^2+4)}{u(u+1)^2}=\frac8u-\frac6{u+1}-\frac{10}{(u+1)^2}.\]
\[=8\ln u-6\ln(1+u)+\frac{10}{1+u}+C=\boxed{4\ln x-6\ln(1+\sqrt x)+\frac{10}{1+\sqrt x}+C}.\]

This image contains problems 3, 4 and 5.

\textbf{3(a)} $x=3\sec\theta$: $\sqrt{x^2-9}=3\tan\theta$, $dx=3\sec\theta\tan\theta\,d\theta$:
\[\int\frac{3\tan\theta\cdot3\sec\theta\tan\theta}{27\sec^3\theta}d\theta=\frac13\int\sin^2\theta\,d\theta=\frac16(\theta-\sin\theta\cos\theta)+C=\boxed{\tfrac16\sec^{-1}\tfrac x3-\frac{\sqrt{x^2-9}}{2x^2}+C}.\]
\textbf{3(b)} By parts twice, $\int x^2e^{x/2}dx=e^{x/2}(2x^2-8x+16)$. So $\int_0^4=16e^2-16$ and the average is $\frac14(16e^2-16)=\boxed{4e^2-4}$.

\textbf{4(a)} $\int_{\sqrt3}^\infty\frac{dx}{x^2+1}=\frac\pi2-\frac\pi3=\boxed{\frac\pi6}$.

\textbf{4(b)} $V=\int_{\sqrt3}^\infty\frac{2\pi x}{x^2+1}dx=\lim_{t\to\infty}\pi\big[\ln(x^2+1)\big]_{\sqrt3}^t=\infty$: \textbf{diverges}.

\textbf{5(a)} With $u=x^2$: $\int_1^3xg(x^2)dx=\frac12\int_1^9g=3$, and $\int_1^33x^2dx=26$. Total \boxed{29}.

\textbf{5(b)} The top is at $y=12$. At height $y$ the water's width is $2\sqrt y$; a slice has volume $6\cdot2\sqrt y\,dy$ and is lifted $12-y$:
\[W=62.5\int_0^412\sqrt y\,(12-y)\,dy=750\Big[8y^{3/2}-\tfrac25y^{5/2}\Big]_0^4=750\Big(64-\frac{64}{5}\Big)=\boxed{38400\ \text{ft-lb}}.\]
